question: Who among the following was appointed as the new Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) in May 2025?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dr. Ajay Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Ajay Kumar** was appointed as the **new Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)** in **May 2025.**
 
• He has an extensive career in the Indian Administrative Services (**IAS**) and has held significant positions in the government.
 
• As the Chairman of **UPSC**, Dr. Ajay Kumar is responsible for conducting prestigious exams such as the **Civil Services Examination**, which recruits candidates for India’s top administrative positions.
 
• The **UPSC** is a constitutional body under **Article 315** of the Indian Constitution, tasked with conducting exams and advising the government on recruitment, transfers, and disciplinary matters.
 
• Dr. Ajay Kumar’s leadership and administrative expertise are expected to enhance the efficiency and fairness of the recruitment process in one of India’s most esteemed institutions.
 
• The appointment of the UPSC Chairman is a crucial decision, as the commission plays a vital role in selecting candidates for the nation’s administrative machinery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shri Rajesh Verma**__

 __
 
• Shri Rajesh Verma is a senior **Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer**. He has served in various capacities, including as the **Secretary to the Government of India**.
 
• He has contributed to policy-making in sectors such as **finance and corporate affairs**.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Anil Kumar**__
 __
 
• Dr. Anil Kumar is a prominent name in the field of **science and technology**.
 
• He has worked in **research and development** and contributed to various projects in his domain.
 
 
 
• **Ms. Priya Sharma**__
 
 
• Ms. Priya Sharma is a known personality in **academics and public service.**
 
• She has been involved in activities related to **education reforms** and social development.
